title: 第3章 我成百吨王了第4章 能力详细一泡尿浇灭了祖坟冒出的青烟
content_zh:
李家人沉默地在村中土路上前行。
路过的一些房屋，漆黑的窗户前能看到有人影晃动，好似有人在借着初升的月色朝外窥探，却没人敢发出声响。
等抵达张家屋外的时候，李家已经汇聚了二十四人。
随着李铁挥挥手。
老一辈李家人熟练地分散在各处，点燃一个个用来迷野兽的药草团子。
拿着竹弩、网兜、猛火油和套马杆的几人，也占据高位，确保不给张家人一点逃脱的机会。
随着众人站好位置。
几个小年轻，包括李青山在内，按着李铁路上的布置，朝着住着人的房屋冲去，对着屋门猛地一踹。
砰砰砰~
伴随一声声木门被踢开的响动。
一个个点燃的草药团子被精准地丢进了一间间房屋内。
紧接着便有哭喊声和咳嗽声从屋里传来。
李青山守在门口一米外，面无表情。
没想到觉醒宿慧后，做的第一件事情就是染血。
...
草药团子丢进屋一两个呼吸的时间，李青山守着的房门内，突然传来一声好似野兽频临死亡时的绝望咆哮。
下一刻，一道身影埋头从房屋内冲出。
好似藏在骨子里的本能一般，李青山刚意识到有人想要冲出来的时候，手上柴刀，已经快准狠地砍在了对方的脖颈。
伴随一捧顺着不规则刀锋迸射而出的血丝打在脸上。
李青山才后知后觉，刀也不拔，抓住对方肩膀，直接将对方软下来的身体拖了出来，顺便让开堵门的位置。

在他身后，正准备补刀的李铁挑了挑眉。
之前在家里，李铁就感觉李青山这个小老弟让他有些陌生，现在更觉自己好像从未真正看清过这个小老弟。
闻着空气中弥漫的铁锈味，他压下心中思绪，提着手上的刀，上前接替了李青山让出来的位置。
...
李青山拖着手上的身体来到空地。
借着月光，他才发现这人是张三的大哥张大。
对方的大儿子，正是张三口中那个长成了武骨的侄子。
在他印象里，张大就像一头只知埋头耕种的老牛，勤恳孝顺，无怨无悔，是妥妥的良家子、老实人。
可惜，李青山是一个屁股决定脑袋的俗人。
斩草不除根，春风吹又生。
张大再无辜，身为张家人，今天就必须死！
张大此时也看清了出手的人。
他瞪大眼睛，死死看向一半脸藏在阴影中的李青山，吐着血沫子，嘴唇蠕动：“为什么...”
content_en:
The Li family walked silently on the dirt road in the village.
In some houses passing by, figures could be seen moving in front of the dark windows, as if someone was peering out under the rising moonlight, but no one dared to make a sound.
By the time they arrived outside the Zhang family house, twenty-four people from the Li family had gathered.
As Li Tie waved his hand.
The older generation of Li family members skillfully dispersed everywhere, lighting herbal dumplings used to charm wild beasts.
Several people armed with bamboo crossbows, net bags, strong fire oil and horse roping poles also occupied high positions to ensure that the Zhang family would not be given a chance to escape.
As everyone stood up.
Several young people, including Li Qingshan, followed the layout of Li Railway, rushed towards the house where people lived, and kicked the door violently.
Bang bang bang~
There was a sound of the wooden door being kicked open.
The lit herbal balls were accurately thrown into each house.
Then there were cries and coughs coming from the house.
Li Qingshan stood one meter away from the door with an expressionless face.
Unexpectedly, after awakening Su Hui, the first thing he did was to be stained with blood.
...
Just a breath or two after the herbal dumplings were thrown into the room, a desperate roar like a beast about to die suddenly came from the door that Li Qingshan was guarding.
The next moment, a figure rushed out of the house with its head buried in the air.
Like an instinct hidden in his bones, when Li Qingshan realized that someone was trying to rush out, the hatchet in his hand had already struck the opponent's neck hard and fast.
Then a handful of blood shot out from the irregular blade and hit his face.
Li Qingshan only realized it later, without drawing the knife, he grabbed the opponent's shoulder and directly dragged the opponent's limp body out, making way for him to block the door.
Behind him, Li Tie, who was about to finish his attack, raised his eyebrows.
Before at home, Li Tie felt that Li Qingshan, this little brother, was a bit strange to him, and now he felt that he had never really seen this little brother clearly.
Smelling the smell of rust in the air, he suppressed his thoughts, held the knife in his hand, and stepped forward to take over the position vacated by Li Qingshan.
...
Li Qingshan dragged his body to the open space.
By the moonlight, he discovered that this person was Zhang San's eldest brother Zhang Da.
The other party's eldest son is the nephew who Zhang Sankou said has grown into a martial artist.
In his impression, Zhang Da is like an old cow who only knows how to work hard. He is diligent, filial, and has no regrets. He is a good and honest man.
It's a pity that Li Qingshan is a layman whose butt determines his head.
Cut the grass without eradicating its roots, but it will grow again when the spring breeze blows.
No matter how innocent Zhang Da is, as a member of the Zhang family, he must die today!
Zhang Da also saw clearly the person who took action at this time.
He widened his eyes and looked at Li Qingshan, whose face was half hidden in the shadows. He was vomiting blood and his lips were moving: "Why..."
